QuestInfo.name: Supply Run
QuestInfo.0: Looks like #bHarpoon#k might finally be ready to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: We're in urgent need of some combat rations. I've heard the #bDinogoth Shoulder Meat#k from over on the #bPath to the Hill#k is very nutritious. Lots of protein. How about collecting around 50 of them?
QuestInfo.2: You provided the troops with Dinogoth Shoulder Meat rations!

0.0: Hello there! I'm Quartermaster Harpoon, and Maroon here is my twin brother.\r\n
0.1: It used to be hard to tell us apart, but now it's much easier. You see, we both like food, but I like extra tasty food! If you still can't tell, our hair colors, horns, and equipment are also different.\r\n
0.2: We really need supplies. Some of our soldiers aren't feeling too good, because we just don't have enough to go around. And don't even ask about the taste!\r\n
0.3: If you could gather around 50 #i4036160:# #bDinogoth Shoulder Meat#k items, we could cook up a decent meal for these hard working soldiers. What do you say?\r\n

yes.0: You'll find #rDinogoth#k monsters near HQ on the #bPath to the Hill#k. I'll get some more bookkeeping done in the meantime.\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k\r\n

1.0: One, two, three... this should be perfect. There's plenty to go around. Thanks!\r\n

yes.0: We still need more supplies, but I need a minute to prep this meat. Like I said, extra tasty is my kinda food!\r\n

default.0: If you could gather around 50 #bDinogoth Shoulder Meat#k items, we could cook up a decent meal for these hard working soldiers. What do you say?\r\n
